arxiv-1910-14487.description: Abstract Charmonium is a valuable probe in heavy-ion collisions to study the properties of the quark gluon plasma, and is also an interesting probe in small collision systems to study cold nuclear matter effects, which are also present in large collision systems.

arxiv-2401-12674.title: Chern numbers in two-dimensional systems with spiral boundary conditions
arxiv-2401-12674.creator: Masaaki Nakamura and Shohei Masuda
arxiv-2401-12674.description: Abstract We discuss methods for calculating Chern numbers of two-dimensional lattice systems using spiral boundary conditions, which sweep all lattice sites in one-dimensional order. Specifically, we establish the one-dimensional representation of Fukui-Hatsugai-Suzuki’s method, based on lattice gauge theory, and the Coh-Vanderbilt’s method, which relates to electronic polarization.

arxiv-2404-17247.title: Analytical derivation and extension of the anti-Kibble-Zurek scaling in the transverse field Ising model
arxiv-2404-17247.creator: Kaito Iwamura, Takayuki Suzuki
arxiv-2404-17247.description: Abstract A defect density which quantifies the deviation from the spin ground state characterizes non-equilibrium dynamics during phase transitions. The widely recognized Kibble–Zurek scaling predicts how the defect density evolves during phase transitions. However, it can be perturbed by a noise, leading to the anti-Kibble–Zurek scaling.

arxiv-2410-14865.title: Joint Verification and Refinement of Language Models for Safety-Constrained Planning
arxiv-2410-14865.creator: Yunhao Yang yunhaoyang234@utexas.edu, Neel P. Bhatt npbhatt@utexas.edu, William Ward wsw568@my.utexas.edu, Zichao Hu zichao@utexas.edu, Joydeep Biswas joydeepb@cs.utexas.edu, Ufuk Topcu utopcu@utexas.edu
arxiv-2410-14865.description: Abstract Large language models possess impressive capabilities in generating programs (e.g., Python) from natural language descriptions to execute robotic tasks. However, these generated programs often contain errors that violate externally given task specifications. Without an effective method to verify their correctness, the reliable deployment of language models in real-world systems is practically infeasible.

arxiv-2502-09452.title: Intrinsic galaxy alignments in the KiDS-1000 bright sample: Dependence on colour, luminosity, morphology, and galaxy scale
arxiv-2502-09452.creator: Christos Georgiou, Nora Elisa Chisari, Maciej Bilicki, Francesco La Barbera, Nicola R. Napolitano, Nivya Roy, Crescenzo Tortora
arxiv-2502-09452.description: Abstract The intrinsic alignment of galaxies is a major astrophysical contaminant to weak gravitational lensing measurements, and the study of its dependence on galaxy properties helps provide meaningful physical priors that aid cosmological analyses. This work studied for the first time the dependence of intrinsic alignments on galaxy structural parameters.

pmc-11476342.title: Triple Combination of Entinostat, a Bromodomain Inhibitor, and Cisplatin Is a Promising Treatment Option for Bladder Cancer
pmc-11476342.creator: Lukas M. Bollmann, Friedrich Lange, Alexandra Hamacher, Lukas Biermann, Linda Schäker-Hübner, Finn K. Hansen, Matthias U. Kassack
pmc-11476342.description: Simple SummaryThe treatment of bladder cancer is still a challenge. New treatment options are required for patients not responding to established chemotherapy (e.g., cisplatin) due to primary or acquired chemoresistance. Bladder cancer cells are known for disturbed epigenetics contributing to resistance.

pmc-11532514.title: Global, Regional, and National Trends Analysis in Incidence of Genital Herpes Among the Population Aged 15–49 Years — Worldwide, 1990–2021
pmc-11532514.creator: Guiying Cao, Jue Liu, Min Liu, Wannian Liang
pmc-11532514.description: What is already known on this topic?Genital herpes infection is a chronic condition that can cause recurrent symptoms, significantly affecting both quality of life and sexual relationships. However, there is currently no available data on the global trends and regional variations in the incidence of genital herpes among individuals of reproductive age.What is added by this report?

pmc-12550975.title: Reproducibility Examination of Histopathological Growth Patterns of Liver Metastases in a Retrospective, Consecutive, Single-Center, Cohort Study with Literature Review
pmc-12550975.creator: Anita Sejben, Szintia Almási, Boglárka Pósfai, Bence Baráth, Ádám Ferenczi, Parsa Abbasi, Tamás Zombori, Tamás Lantos, Ravi P Sahu
pmc-12550975.description: Objectives: Histopathological growth patterns (HGPs) of liver metastases have been shown to possess prognostic significance. To date, only 2 studies have evaluated the reproducibility of HGP assessment. The aim of our study was to assess the interobserver reproducibility of HGP classification in liver metastases.

pmc-12619490.title: Antimicrobial resistance profiles and molecular characterization of extended-spectrum β-lactamase/AmpC-harboring Klebsiella pneumoniae isolated from clinically ill dogs and cats in South Korea
pmc-12619490.creator: Yu-Jeong Hwang, Yeon-Hee Lee, Sekendar Ali, Bo-Youn Moon, Ji-Hyun Choi, Yeon-Kyeong Lee, Hee-Seung Kang, Ji-In Kim, Min Young Kim, Jae-Myung Kim, Suk-Kyung Lim
pmc-12619490.description: BackgroundThe emergence of ESBL/AmpC-producing K. pneumoniae is a significant concern in humans and veterinary medicine. This study aims to ascertain the antimicrobial resistance profiles and molecular characteristics of ESBL/AmpC-producing K. pneumoniae isolated from diseased companion animals during 2018–2023 in South Korea.

pmc-12743872.title: Biomechanical Assessment of Anterior Talofibular Ligament (ATFL) and Calcaneofibular Ligament (CFL) Repair Using Reinforced Bio-inductive Implants in Cadaver Models
pmc-12743872.creator: Atta Taseh, Lercan Aslan, Mohammad Hossein Chegini Kord, Mohamad Al Masri, Ahmad Hedayatzadeh Razavi, Nazanin Nafisi, Colin O'Neill, Kendal Toy, Joaquin Batista, Gregory Waryasz, Christopher Miller, Ara Nazarian, Soheil Ashkani-Esfahani
pmc-12743872.description: Research Type:Level 5 - Case report, Expert opinion, Personal observationIntroduction/Purpose:Lateral ankle instability is a common condition, particularly among athletes, with 70% of affected individuals experiencing residual disability. This instability usually results from chronic laxity of the lateral ankle ligaments, primarily the anterior talofibular ligament (ATFL) and calcaneofibular ligament (CFL).

pmc-13204189.title: A Vascular–Extracellular Matrix Molecular Program Identifies High-Risk Diffuse Glioma Across Independent Multi-Omics
pmc-13204189.creator: Shamsa Hilal Saleh, Arshiya Akbar, Fareeha Arshad, Saniyah Shaikh, Volodymyr Mavrych, Olena Bolgova, Abrar Barakzai, Ahmed Abu-Zaid, Mohammed Imran Khan, Itika Arora, Ahmed Yaqinuddin
pmc-13204189.description: Simple SummaryDiffuse gliomas such as glioblastoma represent biologically heterogeneous brain tumors with few established prognostic biomarkers. One potential limitation of using bulk tumor omics to discover prognostic biomarkers is that the profiles will include both malignant and benign cells, which may obscure the underlying biology of interest.

pmc-13413301.creator: Akifumi Kushiyama, Iori Yamazaki, Haruka Ota, Momoka Kojima, Takako Kikuchi
pmc-13413301.description: Background/Objectives: The relationship between hyperuricemia and diabetic retinopathy (DR) remains controversial despite both conditions being associated with vascular endothelial dysfunction.
